First, let's factor out $3$ from the expression:

$$
12{t}^{2}+75=3\,(4{t}^{2}+25).
$$

Now focus on factoring $(4{t}^{2}+25).$  

To factor a sum of squares, we first write it as a difference. Then, we rewrite the second term using ${i}^{2}=-1.$ Finally, we factor it as a difference of squares.

$$
\begin{aligned}4{t}^{2}+25 & =4{t}^{2}-(-25) \\  & =4{t}^{2}-(25{i}^{2}) \\  & =(2t)^{2}-(5i)^{2} \\  & =(2t+5i)(2t-5i).\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting back, we obtain

$$
3\,(4{t}^{2}+25)=3(2t+5i)(2t-5i).
$$
